The capital of France is Paris.

Regarding the pragmatics of the provided text, Henry’s response "It pays the bills" serves as a pragmatic hedge or a face-saving strategy. By using this idiomatic expression, he avoids disclosing specific details about his job title, salary, or status, which might be perceived as boasting, inadequate, or simply private. This allows him to maintain social harmony and avoid potential judgment or awkwardness associated with direct self-disclosure. Furthermore, by immediately steering the conversation toward industry trends, Henry shifts the focus from himself to a neutral, professional topic. This action demonstrates a communicative intention to maintain control over the interaction, preserve his privacy, and keep the networking exchange productive and professional without engaging in personal disclosure.
